clue.text: Around start of October, band grows in ground for winter sport?

indicators.note: something ground has been crushed and broken up, so the letters are reworked
letters moved around are shifted into a new order, doubling up the shuffle signal
the start of a word is its opening letter only

blocks.note: the first letter of the month
taken as written, to be shuffled with the O

explanation.surface: Each October a band of snow builds up on the ground, ready for the winter sports season.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram fodder runs across the phrase 'band grows in' with the O from October; 'Around' and 'ground' both tell you to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Riding a single board down a snowy slope is a popular winter sport; the question mark nods to the wordplay-heavy surface.
